description: Section 2 (built-but-gated-off): add coupon and gift-card support to the website checkout. Server/Wix-authoritative coupon validation and discounts; a secure gift-card replacement for the current blanket Cart V2 rejection implementing 'authoritative total - verified redemption = Razorpay payable (integer paise)' with full edge-case handling, reservation/rollback, reconciliation and tests. The coupon/gift-card authority is modeled server-side behind an abstracted provider seam (concrete Wix-native vs third-party binding deferred, per the open question). All real-money paths stay behind the SAME disabled gate; no real charge is enabled; no third-party provider name is surfaced in customer-facing UI.
steps: Study cart_v2.py's current gift-card handling (CartV2.calculate raises CartContractError on paymentSummary.giftCards / split / deferred, and requires payNow==totalAfterGiftCards==total ~lines 132-141) and website_checkout.py / checkout_pricing.py. Do NOT simply delete the protection; design the authoritative replacement around it.

Define an abstracted redemption-authority seam (e.g. amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/redemption.py) with provider-agnostic interfaces for coupon validation and gift-card redemption that return server-authoritative results (applied discount paise, applied gift-card paise, remaining payable paise, and typed reasons: INVALID/EXPIRED/INELIGIBLE/INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE/DUPLICATE/etc.). Do NOT hard-code a third-party vendor; model as Wix/backend-authoritative so the concrete provider (Wix Headless coupons / Wix gift cards OR a third-party system) can be bound later. Verify current official Wix Headless coupon / gift-card API shapes from official docs (OPEN_INTERNET) and record what the real binding will require, but keep the seam abstract.

COUPON (server/Wix-authoritative): implement coupon apply/remove producing an authoritative discounted total in integer paise. Never trust a browser-calculated discount. Surface typed states for the UI: applied discount, invalid, expired, ineligible. The discounted total feeds the existing checkout_pricing calculator (convenience fee + GST on the authoritative collection total).

GIFT CARD (secure replacement, integer paise): implement the computation authoritativeTotalPaise - verifiedRedemptionPaise = razorpayPayablePaise with full edge cases: partial redemption, full redemption (zero remaining -> no Razorpay charge), invalid card, expired card, insufficient balance, duplicate redemption, concurrent redemption (atomic reservation keyed so two clicks cannot double-spend), failed Razorpay payment after a gift-card reservation (reservation rollback/release), refunds, and payment/order reconciliation. Use integer paise throughout; the browser never controls the trusted amount. Reuse order_keys reservation/claim/quarantine primitives and payment_attempt where applicable. Replace the blanket cart_v2 rejection with this verified path ONLY within the gated flow - the standalone cart_v2.calculate contract may keep rejecting unverified gift cards; the new verified redemption is applied server-side after authoritative verification.

Keep EVERYTHING gated: any payable path (reduced Razorpay payable after redemption, including the full-gift-card zero-remaining settlement) sits behind the SAME CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED gate (default off) and readiness. Gate off => PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED, no gateway order. No constant forces it on. A zero-remaining (fully gift-card-covered) order must still be gated and must settle through the authoritative verification path, never auto-complete from browser state.

Frontend (gated, honest): add the cart/checkout coupon and gift-card UI to src/pages/cart.tsx (which already uses PageTopBand): coupon code field + Apply + Remove + applied discount + invalid/expired/ineligible messages; gift-card code field + Apply + Remove + applied gift-card amount + remaining payable balance. All amounts shown come from the server-authoritative response, never browser math. With the gate off, the flow shows an honest unavailable/disabled state and cannot transact. No 'Gift Up'/'GiftUp'/third-party name anywhere in the UI.

Tests: real pytest coverage driving the actual redemption/checkout functions against tests/crm_fake_dynamo.py with stubbed provider readback, covering every gift-card edge case listed above (especially concurrent/duplicate redemption atomicity, reservation rollback on failed Razorpay, zero-remaining still gated, integer-paise exactness incl. a fixture) and coupon states; plus revert-checks that fail if the gate or an authority guard is reverted. Add vitest coverage for the cart coupon/gift-card UI (fields, Apply/Remove, server-authoritative amounts rendered, disabled state when gated off, no third-party name).

Deliver AWS/Wix-live wiring (concrete provider binding, routes, IAM, env) as source + runbook under docs/execution/ and report BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT (no AWS credentials; no live Wix/Razorpay). Keep the gate disabled. Do NOT execute or fake live calls; any chat-pasted AWS key MUST NOT be used.
Commit to feature/customer-experience-upgrade with explicit-path staging only.
acceptance_criteria: Coupon validation/discount and gift-card redemption amounts are server/Wix-authoritative in integer paise; the browser never controls the trusted amount and a browser-calculated discount is never trusted.

The gift-card path implements authoritativeTotal - verifiedRedemption = Razorpay payable with all listed edge cases including concurrent/duplicate reservation atomicity and reservation rollback on failed Razorpay, with reconciliation; the original cart_v2 protection is replaced by a verified path, not simply removed.

Every payable path (including zero-remaining fully-gift-card orders) stays behind the SAME disabled gate; no constant forces payment on; gate off yields PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED and no gateway order.
The provider is abstracted behind a seam (no hard-coded third-party vendor) and no third-party gift-card provider name appears in any customer-facing UI.

cart.tsx shows coupon + gift-card fields, Apply/Remove, applied discount, applied gift-card amount, remaining payable, and the invalid/expired/ineligible/insufficient messages, all from server-authoritative responses; honest disabled state when gated off.
Real pytest tests (with revert-checks) and vitest tests cover the above and pass; full gate stays green.
AWS/Wix-live wiring delivered as source + runbook, reported BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT, not executed or faked.
verification: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q (coupon/gift-card edge-case + revert-check tests + full suite pass; record counts)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q -k "gift or coupon or redemption" (focused run exercises real functions)
npx vitest run (cart coupon/gift-card UI tests pass)
npm run build (re-run once if the only failure is a transient blog 429)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED, GATED OFF, no live charge enabled.

CART_V2 AUDIT + THE SPLIT: cart_v2.CartV2.calculate STILL raises CartContractError on any paymentSummary.giftCards / split / deferred and still requires payNow==totalAfterGiftCards==total (unchanged, not weakened). That standalone cart contract keeps REJECTING an unverified gift card that Wix's own paymentSummary tried to self-apply, because the cart boundary has no way to verify it. The secure replacement does NOT touch cart_v2: the server computes the authoritative Wix total through the retained cart path, then AFTER an authoritative provider balance readback subtracts a VERIFIED redemption server-side to get the Razorpay payable. Wix never collects a gift card for us; our server does the verified subtraction. The two never disagree because they answer different questions. Documented in redemption.py module docstring.

WHERE COUPON vs GIFT-CARD AMOUNTS APPLY RELATIVE TO THE FEE/GST CALCULATOR (confirmed against checkout_pricing.py docstring): a COUPON is a PRICE CHANGE - it reduces the authoritative collection that FEEDS compute_quote, so the 2.5% convenience fee and 18% GST-on-fee compute on the DISCOUNTED collection (apply_coupon returns discounted_collection_paise). A GIFT CARD is TENDER, not a price change - it is subtracted from the FINAL calculator total AFTER fee+GST: authoritativeTotalPaise (= quote.total_payable_paise) - verifiedRedemptionPaise = razorpayPayablePaise. The 121481-paise fixture is preserved and a redemption test asserts exact integer-paise subtraction against it (21481 -> 100000 remaining).

PROVIDER SEAM (no hard-coded vendor): amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/redemption.py defines an abstract RedemptionProvider Protocol with validate_coupon(...)->CouponAuthority and read_gift_card(...)->GiftCardAuthority, both returning server-authoritative integer paise + typed reasons (APPLIED/INVALID/EXPIRED/INELIGIBLE/INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE; plus DUPLICATE/CONCURRENT/UNAVAILABLE for the reservation layer). No Wix-vs-third-party is baked in; concrete binding (Wix Headless coupons/gift-cards OR a third-party system) is deferred to the runbook. No vendor name anywhere in code or UI.

RESERVATION/ROLLBACK/CONCURRENCY/RECONCILIATION: the prior partial pass's order_keys gift-card primitives were VERIFIED and FINISHED. One correctness fix: gift_card_is_reserved_elsewhere originally used table.scan() which the test FakeDynamo does not implement and which is an O(n) production anti-pattern. Replaced with an EXCLUSIVE card-level lock row GIFTCARDLOCK#<fingerprint> claimed conditionally (O(1), race-safe) before the per-attempt reservation GIFTCARD#<fingerprint>#<attempt>; a different live attempt loses the lock claim and gets a LOCKED_ELSEWHERE marker -> redemption.reserve_redemption maps it to CONCURRENT. The lock is deleted (conditional on owning attempt) when the reservation is RELEASED/REFUNDED so a rolled-back card is immediately redeemable. Commit is exactly-once via GIFTCARDCOMMIT#<paymentId|attempt-marker>. The card code is never stored - only its SHA-256 fingerprint keys rows.

EDGE CASES (all tested, integer paise): partial (balance<total), full/zero-remaining (balance>=total -> payable 0, still gated), invalid, expired, ineligible, insufficient (usable but zero balance), duplicate (same card+attempt resumes same figures, no second subtraction), concurrent (same card, two attempts -> CONCURRENT), failed-Razorpay rollback (release frees the lock), double-release no-op, refund (release committed back with REFUNDED reason), reconciliation (re-derives from the STORED row), zero-remaining commit via attempt marker.

GATE: redemption.py creates NO gateway order. RedeemedPayable.requires_gateway is True ONLY for a strictly positive payable; a zero-remaining order is NOT a captured payment and does not force a gateway order (mirrors CheckoutQuote.is_payable). The reduced/zero payable only reaches website_checkout.prepare_checkout (same CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED gate + readiness) when the gate is on; gate off => PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED, no gateway order, and the cart UI shows the honest unavailable state. No constant forces payment on.

FRONTEND: src/pages/cart.tsx RedemptionPanel adds coupon code field + Apply + Remove + applied discount + invalid/expired/ineligible messages, and gift-card code field + Apply + Remove + applied gift-card amount + remaining payable balance. ALL amounts rendered come from the server response (sends {kind,action,code} ONLY - no amount). Gate off/404/network-fail -> honest 'Discounts and gift cards are not available right now.' No fetch at render/prerender time. No third-party provider name.

REVERT-CHECK TESTS: pytest tests/test_redemption.py::test_revert_check_browser_discount_is_never_trusted (apply_coupon has no browser-discount parameter and uses only the provider figure), ::test_revert_check_gift_card_zero_remaining_still_gated (zero payable has requires_gateway False and is not a captured payment, reconciles exactly), ::test_revert_check_concurrent_card_cannot_double_spend (atomic cross-attempt guard; second attempt -> CONCURRENT). Vitest src/test/CartRedemption.test.tsx covers fields/Apply/Remove, server-authoritative amounts rendered, disabled state when gated, code+action-only payload, no vendor name.

RUNBOOK (BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT): docs/execution/coupon-giftcard-provisioning-runbook-2026-10-01.md - concrete provider binding, /ecommerce/redemption route, GIFTCARD#/GIFTCARDLOCK#/GIFTCARDCOMMIT# storage (no new table), IAM reuse, gate-off verification. No AWS creds / no live Wix/Razorpay; nothing executed or faked.

GATE COUNTS (post-change): pytest 6073 passed / 1 skipped (baseline 6042+31 new); vitest 743 passed / 54 files (baseline 729+14 new); tsc --noEmit exit 0; npm run build exit 0 / 1409 URLs. The 121481-paise checkout_pricing fixture still passes.
